items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: The interviewee discusses Benny Goodman in the context of answering a trivia question about Fletcher Henderson and mentions a third party (George Duvivier) who had a 'run-in' with Goodman, but no personal interaction or direct professional relationship between Vincent Pelote and Benny Goodman is des

ctx.x: Did you get — what kind of questions did people ask you?

All right. I was very young at the time, okay? In fact Chris White was the director at the time, so we are talking ’74, ’75. I was still in college, wet behind the ears just really sort of getting into the whole jazz thing. And the kind of questions that were sent were sort of like — I guess you call them trivia questions now you know. What recording did Rahsaan Roland Kirk play a sarrusophone on or some things like that. Also I will confess now that the magazine is defunct that some of those questions were…
He wasn’t that effective a leader.
